title: Spinning Swing
description: Spin your weapon around yourself, dealing weapon damage to all adjacent targets. Afterwards, you must perform an acrobatics check of (PL*3) or fall prone.

title: Impact
description: A powerful blow with the user’s full weight behind it. When hit, the opponent must make a strength contest against the user. If they lose, they get knocked back (PL*5) ft.

title: Heavy Blow
description: On hit, the opponent has to make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3), or lose one reaction for the rest of the round.

title: Bone Breaker
description: A strike that sends shockwaves through your opponent’s body. On hit, they must make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3). If they fail, their movement is halved for 2 turns.

title: Shatter
description: A powerful hit with large wind up and centrifugal force. If blocked, the opponent must make a fortitude check with a DC of your (PL*3+3). If failed, their block only lessens 25% of the damage for 2 turns.

title: Artery Knick
description: Perform a slashing attack attempting to target an opponent’s vitals. If you hit, the target must roll a Fortitude check against a DC equal to your Technique Level * 3. If they fail, they suffer from the Bleed condition.

title: Descending Slash
description: A downward slashing attack performed from high up, dealing an additional 1d4 for every 10 ft. fallen. At a base, jump up 10 ft. to perform this technique. After 20 ft. fallen, take 1d4 (unmitigatable and unreactable) recoil damage for every 10 ft. fallen.

title: Sword Dance
description: Perform a slashing attack. You may then move up to 10ft. freely without consuming movement speed.

title: Disarming Shot
description: Make a Ranged attack that deals half damage. If you hit, the target must make a Fortitude or Acrobatics check against a DC equal to your Speed Level * 3. If they fair, an item they are currently holding is sent 15ft. away from the target in a random direction.

title: Covering Fire
description: Reaction. You may attempt to intercept a projectile in your weapon range by rolling a Precision check against a DC equal to your Speed Level * 3. If you succeed, reduce the Projectile's Roll to Hit by your Speed Level + 3.

title: Unloading Shot
description: You may make two Ranged attacks with your weapon of choice in a single Action. Each shot knocks the opponent back 5ft if they are within 15ft. of you. However, you have a -2 to all Speed Rolls until the end of your next turn.

title: Ricochet Shot
description: Roll a Ranged Sneak Attack. You may ricochet the attack off of a surface to hit any target that's within 30ft. of that spot.

title: Debilitating Shot
description: Make a Ranged Attack against a target, aiming for either one of their hands or one of their legs. If you hit, the target receives a debuff for 1d4 turns (this debuff may be healed through RCT). If you hit their hand, the target suffers a penalty on rolls to hit and Domain Expansions equal to your Speed Level/2 rounded down. If you hit their leg, the target's move speed is reduced by 20ft.

title: Perfect Shot
description: Spend Two Actions preparing to make a Ranged Attack. You must not receive damage or take any other actions during this time. If you successfully prepare this attack, the next Ranged Attack you make deals double damage and becomes undodgeable. (Black Flash overrides this attack's damage multiplier.)
